# Define sensmeth and corresponding main analyses 
```{r}
# Read in raw seonlyseropos data 
dat_l <- list()
dat_l$seonlyseropos_s08 <- lapply(str_subset(str_subset(str_subset(
  list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"), "seonlyseropos"), "multi", 
  negate = TRUE), readRDS)
names(dat_l$seonlyseropos_s08) <- sub(
  ".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v1)_s08.*", "\\1", str_subset(str_subset(str_subset(
  list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"), "seonlyseropos"), "multi", negate = TRUE))

patseonlyseropos_sel <- names(dat_l$seonlyseropos)

# Read in corresponding mean analyses data 
dat_l$s08 <- lapply(str_subset(str_subset(str_subset(
    list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), 
    "s08.rds"), "datase|multi", negate = TRUE), paste(patseonlyseropos_sel, collapse = "|")), readRDS)
names(dat_l$s08) <- sub(
  ".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v1)_s08.*", "\\1", str_subset(str_subset(str_subset(
    list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}")), "s08.rds"), "datase|multi", negate = TRUE), 
    paste(patseonlyseropos_sel, collapse = "|")))
```

# Raw data 
```{r}
# Read in the waic (only models that converged)
waic_seonlyseropos <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waic.rds")) %>%
  filter(pat %in% patseonlyseropos_sel, dat %in% c("seonlyseropos_s08", "s08"), mod_out == "imm")
# Read in samples
sam_seonlyseropos <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_samples.rds")) %>%
  filter(pat %in% patseonlyseropos_sel, dat %in% c("seonlyseropos_s08", "s08"), mod_out == "imm")
# Read in data gaps
all_datagaps <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagaps.rds"))
```

# Check WAIC =======================================================================================

# Prepare data 
```{r}
# Bring data together 
waic_seonlyseropos_pl <- waic_seonlyseropos %>%
  arrange(pat, dat, waic) %>%
  group_by(pat, mod_out, dat) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1])
```

# Check waic of mvn and compare to corresponding uvn 
```{r}
waic_seonlyseropos_pl %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delta_waic, y = mod_name, color = dat)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 2), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = 0, yend = mod_name), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) + 
    scale_x_continuous("Delta WAIC (log10)", trans = "log10") + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "forestgreen")) +
    facet_nested_wrap(~pat_tidy+dat, nest_line = TRUE, solo_line = TRUE, ncol = 10) +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
```

# Compare the coefficients of the mvn and unv models ===============================================

# Plot it 
```{r}
sampl_l <- list()
sampl_l <- sapply(c("csi_reg_6", "csi_reg_4", "csi_reg_3", "csi_reg_2", "cs"), function(x) {
  # Filter accordingly 
  datpl <- filter(sam_seonlyseropos, mod_name == x) %>%
    distinct(pat, pat_tidy, imm_name, reg, clu, clu_tidy, multi, dat,
           sam_amp_mean, sam_amp_ci95lo, sam_amp_ci95up, 
           sam_phi_mean, sam_phi_ci95lo, sam_phi_ci95up) %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("sam_"), names_pattern = "sam_(amp|phi)_(mean|ci95lo|ci95up)",
                 names_to = c("param", "summary")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = summary, values_from = value) %>%
    mutate(ci95lo1 = ci95lo,
           ci95up1 = if_else(param == "phi" & ci95lo >= ci95up, 52, ci95up),
           ci95lo2 = if_else(param == "phi" & ci95lo >= ci95up, 0, NA),
           ci95up2 = if_else(param == "phi" & ci95lo >= ci95up,  ci95up, NA))
  
  pl_l <- list()
  for(p in c("amp", "phi")) {
    pl_l[[p]] <- filter(datpl, param == p, str_detect(pat, "strep", negate = TRUE)) %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = mean, y = dat, color = dat)) + 
      geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 1)) + 
      geom_segment(aes(x = ci95lo1, xend = ci95up1), position = position_dodge(width = 1)) + 
      geom_segment(aes(x = ci95lo2, xend = ci95up2), position = position_dodge(width = 1)) + 
      scale_y_discrete("") + 
      scale_color_manual("MVN", values = c("red", "dodgerblue3")) + 
      facet_nested(pat_tidy+clu_tidy~., 
                   nest_line = TRUE, solo_line = TRUE, scales = "free", space = "free_y")  +
      theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
            legend.position = "top") + 
      ggtitle(x)
    if(p == "amp") {
      pl_l[[p]] <- pl_l[[p]] + 
        scale_x_continuous("Amplitude", trans = "log") + 
        geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey")
    }
    if(p == "phi") {
      pl_l[[p]] <- pl_l[[p]] + 
        scale_x_continuous("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), expand = c(0,0)) 
    }
  }
  # Bring plots together
   return(pl_l$amp + pl_l$phi)
}, simplify = FALSE)

sampl_l$csi_reg_6
```

# Compare the spaguetti plots of the mvn and unv models ============================================

# Prepare data 
```{r} 
datplsam_seonlyseropos <- sam_seonlyseropos %>%
  filter(sam_no <= 100, checkgaps_all == FALSE) %>%
  crossing(vac_week_v1 = seq(from = 0, to = 2*pi, length = 53)) %>%
  mutate(sam_estimate = exp(p_cos*cos(vac_week_v1) + p_sin*sin(vac_week_v1)),
         mean_estimate = exp(p_cos_mean*cos(vac_week_v1) + p_sin_mean*sin(vac_week_v1)),
         vac_week_v1 = round((52*vac_week_v1)/(2*pi))) %>%
  left_join(distinct(all_datagaps, mod, clu, imm_name, vac_week_v1, tot), 
            by = join_by(mod, clu, imm_name, vac_week_v1))

datpl_sam_rug <- distinct(datplsam_seonlyseropos, mod_name, dat, multi, vac_week_v1, tot, clu_tidy, 
                          pat, pat_tidy, phi_mean) %>%
  mutate(vac_week_v1 = case_when(!is.na(tot) ~ vac_week_v1)) 
```

# Samples plot 
```{r}
spapl_l <- sapply(c("csi_reg_6", "csi_reg_4", "csi_reg_3", "csi_reg_2", "cs"), function(x) {
  # Identify pathogens per model region 
  pat_reg <- filter(datplsam_seonlyseropos, dat == "seonlyseropos_s08", mod_name == x) %>%
    distinct(pat)
  # Plot each of the combinations
  pl_l <- list()
  for(i in pat_reg$pat) {
  pl_l[[i]] <- filter(datplsam_seonlyseropos, mod_name == x, pat == i) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = sam_estimate, group = paste0(sam_no, dat), color = phi_mean)) + 
    geom_line(alpha = 0.1) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_estimate, group = 1), size = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous("Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), expand = c(0,0)) +
    scale_y_continuous("Conditional effect", expand = c(0.2,0)) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      "Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52),
      colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"), rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"))),
      guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5, barheight = 0.8)) +
    geom_point(data = filter(datpl_sam_rug, mod_name == x, pat == i), 
               aes(y = -Inf), group = 1, shape = "|", size = 3) +
    facet_nested_wrap(paste0(pat_tidy, " (", dat, ")")~clu_tidy, 
                      scales = "free_y", nest_line = TRUE, solo_line = TRUE, nrow = 2) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  return(pl_l)
}, simplify = FALSE)

spapl_l$cs
spapl_l$csi_reg_6
```

Conclusion: Basically the same!

# Compare the prediction
```{r}
pred_l <- sapply(str_subset(waic_seonlyseropos$mod, "reg_6"), function(x) {
  # Get model information
  waic_mod <- waic_seonlyseropos[waic_seonlyseropos$mod == x, ]
  sens <- str_remove_all(waic_mod$dat, "_|s08")
  # Read in data from the model 
  dat <- readRDS(paste0(dirs$modfit, "/data", sens,"_brms_", waic_mod$pat[[1]], "_v", waic_mod$vac[[1]], 
                        "_s08.rds"))
  # Tidy mod_reg 
  mod_reg <- if(str_detect(waic_mod$mod_name[[1]], "reg")) str_remove(waic_mod$mod_name[[1]], "csi_")
  # Read in 20 predictions from the model 
  as.data.frame(t(readRDS(glue("{dirs$pred}/pred_{x}")))) %>%
      select(1:100) %>%
      bind_cols(data.frame(
        data = dat$imm_val_s1,
        imm_cutoff_s1 = dat$imm_cutoff_s1,
        imm_cutoff_min = min(dat$imm_val_s1),
        reg = if(!is.null(mod_reg)) dat[,mod_reg][[1]] else NA
      )) %>%
      pivot_longer(-c(reg, imm_cutoff_s1, imm_cutoff_min)) %>%
      mutate(type = case_when(name == "data" ~ "2data", .default = "1draw"))
    }, simplify = FALSE)

# Separate in two data frames
preddf_l <- bind_rows(pred_l[str_subset(names(pred_l), paste(patseonlyseropos_sel, collapse = "|"))], .id = "mod") %>%
    left_join(distinct(waic_seonlyseropos, mod, pat, pat_tidy), by = join_by(mod)) %>% 
    mutate(name_draw = paste0(name,reg)) 
```

```{r}
preddf_l %>%
    filter(type == "1draw") %>%
    mutate(value = case_when(pat != "rota" & value <= imm_cutoff_s1 ~ imm_cutoff_min, 
                             pat == "rota" & value <= 20 ~ 20, 
                             , .default = value)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = value, group = name_draw, color = as.character(reg))) + 
    geom_line(stat = "ecdf", alpha = 0.01) + 
    geom_line(data = filter(preddf_l, type == "2data") %>%
                mutate(value = case_when(pat != "rota" & value <= imm_cutoff_s1 ~ imm_cutoff_min, 
                                         pat == "rota" & value <= 20 ~ 20, .default = value)), 
              stat = "ecdf", linetype = "dashed") +  
    facet_grid(mod~as.character(reg), scales = "free") +
    scale_x_continuous("Immunogenicity (log10)", trans = "log10") + 
    scale_color_viridis_d("", option = "mako", na.value = "grey50", begin = 0, end = 0.8) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
filter(preddf_l, type == "2data") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = value)) + 
    geom_line(stat = "density") + 
    scale_x_continuous("Immunogenicity (log10)", trans = "log10") + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
```
